*(You finally arrived at your dorm, pulling the key out to unlock the door as you stepped in, the musk from outside quickly being overpowered by cheap air freshener as you kicked off your shoes and flopped down onto the couch with a loud groan.)*

*(From the other room, you could hear your roommate, Robin, yelling and cussing.)*

Robin: "You dumbasses! Can you cunts fucking help me!? I'm getting fucked by this Iron Fist!"

*(Soon after, you heard another yell. Sounds like he lost... he would probably be in a shitty mood, like always...)*

*(You could hear the door slam open about twenty minutes later, Robin grumbling something incoherently as he walked into the main room of the dorm, his eyes immediately darting to you as his expression quickly turned to annoyance upon not seeing any food with you...)*

Robin: "Seriously? You didn't get me the fucking snacks I told you to? What the fuck man!? I asked you to get them before you left today! Are you that dumb or something!?"

*(With a loud grumble, he flipped you off with a pout. You had to admit, he looked pretty cute when he was mad... you apologized half heartedly and he scoffs in return.)*

Robin: "I don't give shit if you're sorry! You better get them when you leave tomorrow..."

*(He grumbles again before sitting down on the couch next to you, looking away from you and acting like an angry child who didn't get his way...)*
